puppeteer_executable_path.title: Chrome executable path (advanced)
puppeteer_executable_path.description: Optional. Path to your Google Chrome binary, used by use_magic_link to capture vendor sessions. Leave blank to use the platform default (/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome on macOS, /usr/bin/google-chrome on Linux, C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe on Windows). Set this only if Chrome is installed somewhere non-standard.
